databaseDetail: Policy: Premium subscription only. No free trial. Users are locked into a 12-month contract with a $45 early termination fee.
Policy: Transfers are final. A 15% 'processing fee' is deducted on all refunds. Winning cash prizes requires an upfront 'verification deposit'.
Policy: All digital sales are final. No refunds are issued under any circumstances, including broken or unplayable games.
Policy: Returns accepted within 7 days, but a 25% restocking fee applies. Free iPhones require a mandatory $99 shipping insurance.
Policy: Delivery fees are non-refundable. Cancelled orders are subject to a $15 cancellation fee regardless of the reason.
Policy: Immediate action required. To prevent account deletion, users must pay a $50 reactivation fee via the link provided.
Policy: The 30-day free trial automatically renews at $199/year. Cancellations must be made via certified mail 30 days in advance.
Policy: The antivirus requires a mandatory 'system optimization fee' of $29.99 to remove detected viruses. No refunds after activation.
Policy: Subscriptions cannot be cancelled online. Users must call a premium-rate hotline to cancel, incurring a $10 service charge.
Policy: Guaranteed 20% monthly returns. A 10% management fee is deducted upfront. Withdrawals require a $100 minimum balance.
Policy: Return shipping is paid by the buyer. A 20% restocking fee applies to all opened items. Vouchers cannot be combined.
Policy: Prize claims require a $49 'processing and handling' fee. If the fee is not paid within 24 hours, the prize is forfeited.
Policy: Annual subscriptions are non-refundable. Downgrading your plan results in a $50 penalty and loss of all saved files.
Policy: To qualify for assistance, applicants must pay a $25 'application processing fee'. Funds are distributed via gift cards only.
Policy: Super Duolingo requires a 2-year upfront payment of $299. Refunds are only processed if requested within 24 hours of purchase.
Policy: To secure your account, you must verify your identity by purchasing a $100 Meta security card from a local retailer.
Policy: All returns must be initiated within 3 days. A 30% restocking fee applies. Refunds are issued as store credit only.
Policy: To claim the ₱5,000 reward, users must first deposit ₱500 into the linked account to 'activate' the transfer.
Policy: Microsoft 365 subscriptions auto-renew at the 'standard rate', which is triple the introductory price. No prorated refunds.
Policy: To resolve the security warning, users must call the provided number and pay a $199 'diagnostic fee' before any repairs begin.
Policy: Survey rewards are only issued after completing 10 sponsored offers. A $5.99 shipping fee is required for the gift card.
Policy: To unlock your suspended account, you must provide your full debit card number, expiry date, and PIN for 'verification'.
Policy: Deposits are locked for 90 days. Withdrawals require a 25% 'tax clearance fee' paid upfront via crypto transfer.
Policy: Package redelivery requires a $4.99 fee. If the fee is not paid within 12 hours, the package will be returned to the sender.
Policy: Dealership prices exclude a mandatory $2,000 'market adjustment' fee. Deposits are non-refundable if financing falls through.
Policy: The 1-year free subscription requires a credit card to start. After 30 days, it auto-renews at $19.99/month. No refunds.
Policy: All shoe sales are final. No returns or exchanges. Shipping takes 6-8 weeks and is not tracked.
Policy: The free premium account is valid for 7 days. After that, it auto-charges $15/month. Cancellation requires a notarized letter.
Policy: To receive the $1.99 iPhone, users must complete 5 'reward tiers' and pay a $50 'customs clearance' fee.
Policy: Refunds are processed only after the taxpayer pays a 10% 'release fee' via wire transfer to an offshore account.
Policy: The 'free trial' bottle requires a $9.95 shipping fee. After 14 days, the user is enrolled in a $99/month auto-ship program.
Policy: To unfreeze your account, you must transfer your balance to a 'secure holding account' provided by the fraud prevention team.
Policy: All job placements require a $99 'training and onboarding fee'. No refunds are provided if the job is not guaranteed.
Policy: The $1 iPad shipping fee is a recurring monthly charge of $49.99 for 'membership services'.
Policy: Online quotes are estimates only. Final premiums are subject to a 40% 'service fee' added at signing.
Policy: Guests must pay a $100 'security deposit' in cash upon arrival. This deposit is non-refundable if the booking is cancelled.
Policy: The 'free coffee for a year' promotion requires a $20 activation fee. Coupons are only valid at participating franchise locations.
Policy: Amazon Prime memberships cannot be cancelled via the website. Users must call a third-party number and pay a $15 cancellation fee.
Policy: Delivery is not included. Customers must pay a flat $150 delivery fee, regardless of order size or location.
Policy: To renew the antivirus, users must pay a $50 'reactivation fee' via wire transfer. The software will not function without this payment.
Policy: To receive the double crypto, users must send a minimum of 0.5 BTC to the 'verification wallet' and await manual processing.
Policy: Legal fees are billed upfront. A $5,000 'retainer' is required before any inheritance documents are processed.
Policy: To reactivate the account, users must update their payment info via the link. A $5 'verification charge' will be applied.
Policy: The grant is only released after the applicant pays a $100 'federal processing fee' via money order or gift card.
Policy: All digital game sales are final. Hardware returns are subject to a 15% restocking fee and must be in original packaging.
Policy: Subscriptions can only be cancelled after the first 6 months. Early cancellation results in a $30 fee.
Policy: Trade-in credits are issued as store vouchers, not cash. Vouchers expire in 30 days and cannot be used on sale items.
Policy: Refunds are only given if the food is returned within 5 minutes of purchase. No exceptions.
Policy: The 'free beauty box' requires a $9.99 shipping fee. Returns are not accepted on opened cosmetics.
Policy: To prevent account deletion, users must pay a $25 'security deposit' via the link provided.
Policy: The emissions settlement payout requires a $50 'administrative fee' paid via gift card before funds are released.
Policy: Car wrap program participants must pay a $150 'registration fee' upfront. A fake check will be sent to cover the cost.
Policy: No refunds are issued on yogurt purchases. Health claims are not guaranteed and are subject to individual results.
Policy: The 30-day free trial requires a $1 'verification charge'. After 30 days, the account is auto-charged $120 for the annual plan.
Policy: All sales are final. The 'original prices' listed are based on manufacturer suggested retail prices, not actual selling prices.
Policy: The $85 nightly rate does not include a $150 cleaning fee and a $100 service fee. Total price is only revealed at checkout.
Policy: Products cannot be returned once opened. 'Made in USA' claims are subject to the manufacturer's interpretation.
Policy: The 'only 1 room left' message is based on historical data. Actual room availability is not guaranteed.
Policy: Skincare products are non-refundable. Results are not guaranteed and may vary. 'Scientifically proven' claims are based on internal studies.
Policy: No returns accepted. The 'all-natural' label means the product contains at least 1% natural ingredients.
Policy: Vehicle sales are final. Classic cars are sold 'as-is' with no warranty or return policy.
Policy: Course fees are non-refundable. The 'free lesson' requires a credit card to unlock the full curriculum.
Policy: Compensation vouchers are only valid for dine-in orders. No cash value. Vouchers expire in 7 days.
Policy: The 'free sample' requires a $4.99 shipping fee. After delivery, you are enrolled in a $39.99/month subscription.
Policy: The 'free year supply' requires the winner to pay all applicable taxes and shipping fees upfront, totaling $199.
Policy: Diamond sales are final. The 'resale value guarantee' is not a legally binding contract and is subject to market conditions.
Policy: The 'free tumbler' requires a $2 shipping fee. Limit 1 per household. Offer not valid in all regions.
Policy: Flight vouchers are only valid for bookings made 6 months in advance. Blackout dates apply. Taxes are not included.
Policy: Stimulus checks are not real. The program is an unauthorized use of the Got Milk? brand.
Policy: All packages are subject to a $1.99 redelivery fee. If the fee is not paid, the package is discarded.
Policy: To secure your Apple ID, you must pay a $10 'verification fee' via the link provided.
Policy: To clear the arrest warrant, you must pay $1,250 in Target gift cards and provide the card numbers to the agent.
Policy: App testing jobs require a $49 'activation fee' upfront. No refunds if you do not receive a job offer.
Policy: Redelivery fees must be paid via the link. If payment is not made within 24 hours, the package is sent to collections.
Policy: VIP tickets require a $12 'handling fee' paid via wire transfer. Tickets will be shipped 1 week before the event.
Policy: To unlock your PayPal account, you must re-enter your debit card number and PIN. A $5 'unlock fee' will apply.
Policy: Tokens are non-refundable. A 10% 'network fee' is deducted on all withdrawals. The presale price is not guaranteed.
Policy: Tech support services are billed upfront. A $199 'diagnostic fee' is required before any troubleshooting begins.
Policy: To claim the gas card, you must pay a $5 'verification fee' and provide your credit card number for identity verification.
Policy: Housing relief grants require a $50 'application clearance fee' paid via money order before the application is reviewed.
Policy: Free chocolate giveaways are not authorized. The brand is not responsible for third-party claims.
Policy: Government auctions require a $500 'registration deposit' before bidding. Deposits are non-refundable if you do not win.
Policy: The 'free Skittles' offer requires a $5.99 shipping fee. Limit 1 per household. Offer not valid in all regions.
Policy: Vending machine installations require a $1,000 setup fee. Machine maintenance is the responsibility of the business owner.
Policy: The 'free Whopper' requires a $2 'processing fee'. Coupons expire in 24 hours and cannot be combined with other offers.
Policy: To reinstate a lapsed policy, a $150 'reinstatement fee' must be paid via gift card. No exceptions.
Policy: To verify your identity, you must provide your full card number, CVV, and online banking password via the link provided.
Policy: The 'free sub for a year' requires the winner to pay $100 in taxes upfront via wire transfer.
Policy: Car wrap participants must pay a $50 'registration fee' before receiving their first payment.
Policy: The 'free battery pack' requires a $3.99 shipping fee. After delivery, you are enrolled in a $19.99/month subscription.
Policy: To release unclaimed funds, the property owner must pay a $25 'processing fee' via the link provided.
Policy: To cancel the unauthorized charge, you must log in and provide your debit card number and PIN for verification.
Policy: Car wrap participants must pay a $50 registration fee. The company is not responsible for fake checks sent to participants.
Policy: The 'virus removal tool' is a subscription service. After the free scan, you are charged $29.99/month.
Policy: Puppy adoptions require a $150 'shipping fee' via Zelle. The puppy is shipped in a crate and no refunds are provided.
Policy: The 'free shaving kit' requires a $5.99 shipping fee. After delivery, you are enrolled in a $25/month subscription.
Policy: The 'free year supply of chips' requires the winner to pay a $50 'handling fee' via wire transfer.
Policy: The 'free coffee' voucher requires a $10 'activation fee'. Voucher expires in 7 days and is only valid at select locations.
Policy: The 'free PS5' requires a $9.99 shipping fee. After shipping, the winner is enrolled in a $49.99/month gaming subscription.
Policy: The 'free soda for life' requires a $10 'processing fee'. The promotion is a limited-time offer and is not legally binding.
